title: Minimum Add to Make Parentheses Valid
description: A parentheses string is valid if it is empty or can be built from balanced pairs of `'('` and `')'`. Given a string `s` consisting only of `'('` and `')'`, return the minimum number of parentheses you must insert at any positions to make `s` valid.
hints: Track the count of currently unmatched '(' (openCount) and unmatched ')' (adds).
When you see ')', decrement openCount if positive, otherwise increment adds; at the end return adds + openCount.

examples.explanation: Insert one '(' at the start of "())" to form "(())".
Insert three ')' at the end of "(((" to form "((()))".
